blocks.raw: DriveWealth offers historical charts for Equities securities.
blocks.text: DriveWealth offers historical charts for Equities securities.

blocks.raw: A key feature of any investing platform is displaying a historical chart of a selected security. DriveWealth provides historical data in pipe delineated form, based on the time and compression range indicated in the API request.
blocks.text: A key feature of any investing platform is displaying a historical chart of a selected security. DriveWealth provides historical data in pipe delineated form, based on the time and compression range indicated in the API request.

blocks.raw: The `data` always follows the same structure and is what should be utilized to build a chart: \{timestamp}, open, high, low, close, volume). When consuming the data it’s generally recommended to plot the chart given the `close` price of that given day.
blocks.text: The data always follows the same structure and is what should be utilized to build a chart: {timestamp}, open, high, low, close, volume). When consuming the data it’s generally recommended to plot the chart given the close price of that given day.

blocks.raw: To determine which compression value to use will depend on what timeframe your user wants displayed. For example, if a user wants to see how a particular security did for a single day, use a smaller compression value, like 5 minutes or even 1 minute. When a user views a longer time frame, like one week, using a 30 minute or 1 hour compression rate is more suitable. The lower the compression value the more data you will receive for a given period.

| 4                 | 5 Minutes      |
| 8                 | 30 Minutes     |
| 9                 | 1 Hour         |
| 10                | 1 Week         |
